entries.name: hipblasCreate
entries.notes: Create hipBLAS context handle. Cache this — one per GPU.

entries.name: hipblasSgemm
entries.signature: hipblasStatus_t hipblasSgemm(hipblasHandle_t handle, hipblasOperation_t transa, hipblasOperation_t transb, int m, int n, int k, const float *alpha, const float *A, int lda, const float *B, int ldb, const float *beta, float *C, int ldc)
entries.notes: Single-precision GEMM on AMD GPU. C = alpha * op(A) * op(B) + beta * C. HIP mirrors CUDA cublasSgemm API.

entries.name: hipblasDgemm
entries.signature: hipblasStatus_t hipblasDgemm(hipblasHandle_t handle, hipblasOperation_t transa, hipblasOperation_t transb, int m, int n, int k, const double *alpha, const double *A, int lda, const double *B, int ldb, const double *beta, double *C, int ldc)
entries.notes: Double-precision GEMM on AMD GPU. Same interface as hipblasSgemm but FP64.

entries.name: hipfftPlan1d
entries.signature: hipfftResult hipfftPlan1d(hipfftHandle *plan, int nx, hipfftType type, int batch)
entries.notes: Create 1D FFT plan. ROCm equivalent of cufftPlan1d.

entries.name: hipfftExecR2C
entries.notes: Real-to-complex FFT on AMD GPU. ROCm equivalent of cufftExecR2C.

entries.name: hipfftExecC2C
entries.signature: hipfftResult hipfftExecC2C(hipfftHandle plan, hipfftComplex *idata, hipfftComplex *odata, int direction)
entries.notes: Complex-to-complex FFT on AMD GPU. ROCm equivalent of cufftExecC2C.

entries.name: hipMalloc
entries.notes: Allocate device memory on AMD GPU. ROCm equivalent of cudaMalloc.

entries.name: hipMemcpy
entries.signature: hipError_t hipMemcpy(void* dst, const void* src, size_t count, hipMemcpyKind kind)
entries.notes: Copy memory between host and device. ROCm equivalent of cudaMemcpy.

entries.name: hipFree
entries.notes: Free device memory on AMD GPU. ROCm equivalent of cudaFree.

steps.notes: Create hipBLAS handle. Do this once at startup, not per call.

steps.args_hint: handle, HIPBLAS_OP_N, HIPBLAS_OP_N, m, n, k, &alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, &beta, C, ldc
steps.notes: Single-precision matrix multiply on AMD GPU.
Execute real-to-complex FFT on AMD GPU.
